def _get_id(obj, key):
    """
    Get the ID of an object by extracting it from the resource_uri field.
    """
    resource_uri = obj.pop(key, '')
    if resource_uri:
        # i.e. /foo/1/ -> /foo/1 -> ('/foo', '/', '1') -> '1'
        return resource_uri.rstrip('/').rpartition('/')[-1]
